name: BottomNav
summary: Mobile-only primary navigation rail anchored to the bottom of the viewport. 3-5 destinations, icon-on-top + tiny label, active state painted with text.accent + a top-edge brand stroke. Distinct from TabBar (in-page tabs) and from Sidebar (desktop).

items.description: Array of { id, label, icon, badge? }. 3-5 items only — beyond 5, move a destination to the More menu.

showLabels.description: false renders icon-only — only acceptable on app shells where every glyph is universally understood (Home / Search / Notifications / Account).

rules: Each item is a button (or <a> when routing). Active item: aria-current='page'.
Items have ≥ 44 px touch target (the whole item, not just the icon).
Respect safe-area-inset-bottom — the bar pads bottom by max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 8px).
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the active-pill move animation; render only color change.

do: Active state: top-edge 2 px accent stroke + filled icon glyph + text.accent label.
Place the most common destination first (left).
If you have > 5 destinations, the 5th item is 'More' opening a Sheet or DropdownMenu.
Badges on items align to the icon top-right; numeric badges use tabular-nums.
dont: Don't auto-hide the BottomNav on scroll. The user needs the safe-area pad and the orientation cue at all times.
Don't paint the active item background in solid lime. Use the top-edge stroke.
Don't render BottomNav and Sidebar simultaneously — pick the one for the form factor.
Don't add a destructive action to BottomNav. Destinations only.

changelog.note: Initial BottomNav contract. 3-5 items. safe-area padding. Active = top-edge accent stroke.
